sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 760. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Miracle.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 100 Cost.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 40.
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Dawn for 120 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Crimson King's Crest for 120 seconds ([Heraldic] Increases max HP by 500%, increases all stats by 50%, increases all stats for all allies by 50%. Only one Heraldic effect may be active at a time (between both allies and enemies). When a new Heraldic effect is activated, the older effect will be removed. This effect is not affected by Time Slice or Time Extend).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 60 for 120 seconds.
Fire and Time Defense from Unison Damage +600
